description: A check link for a person's own video, and the summary they send back. No argument, or `format` (a format_id): a link at once — `check_link` (`check_link_en` for the English page), `token`, `expires_at` (24 h) and `says` — that the person opens on their phone to upload their own video and get feedback on it against that format's hits. Nothing is read of theirs, written or queued, and you never see their video. Then call again with the `token` alone: `waiting` (ask again after `poll_after_s`) until the person taps «Send this result to the AI chat» («이 결과를 AI 대화에 보내기» on the Korean page) on their result, then `shared` with the summary they sent. Lead with its `cue_check`, as their result screen does: the cues the format's hits share, each with what this video does with it (kept · partly · missed · changed · unclear), a note, its fix, its moment `at_s` and a hit that shows it; one line that sums it up; up to three fixes in order; what the video does well (`strengths`); what it made its own (`own`); and `credits`, what it does that the hits of other trends do too, as counts. `reads_as: another_trend` means it is another kind of video than this format: `near` then names the way of shooting it stands closer to and, in `near.check`, the format to check it against. Beside the cue check, where the measuring check ran: fidelity with its interval and how many axes were measured (`measured` of `of`, `weighted`; its value stays null with reason `not_validated` until its registered validity look passes, with `followed`, k of n directions repeated across formats that the video follows, in its place), up to three measured fixes at their moment (`at_s`, `what_ko`, `how_ko`, the hit video's public still; where a fix was drawn, its `layers`, which hosts that draw show in the check's view), `compared` (the video's value on an axis beside the middle half of the hits'), what they broke and kept, and their result's link (`link`, `link_en`); each line in English beside the Korean where Shorti wrote one. To the person, call it feedback («피드백»). A token this door did not sign, or one past its 24 h with nothing sent, is refused as `handoff_invalid`; a summary sent after the 24 h is still read. 증거가 붙은 관찰로 말하고, 원인은 검증된 것만. 닮은 정도는 조회수 예측이 아니다. — Speak in observations that carry their evidence, and name a cause only where one was verified; a likeness is not a forecast of views.
